judge.rationale: The candidate satisfies all acceptance criteria: it accurately sums usage across tool rounds while ignoring missing rounds and preserving undefined when no round reports usage. In fact, its test for two tool rounds (three provider calls) matches the literal wording of the first acceptance criterion more closely than the reference's two-call test. However, the candidate leaves a `.lore/dod.md` scratch artifact in the diff, introduces a redundant `AggregateUsage` interface in `src/types/ai.ts` (instead of simply renaming the parameter to `totalUsage: UsageMetadata`), and fails to update the `doc-block` in `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md` and `CLAUDE.md` to match the updated `OrchestratorHooks` signature. Additionally, in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate kept the new behavior under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section rather than moving it up to the main specification list as the reference did.
